availableVersions.label: v3.11.0 (Agricultural & Pastoral Economic Valuation Engine Release)
availableVersions.description: Interactive Agricultural & Pastoral Economic Valuation Engine (Beta): Participatory monetization of official county production balances and livestock census headcounts. Formally decouples standing herd capital stock ($869.3B KES national) from annual production flow ($1,157.2B KES national), integrates camels and official livestock products, parameterizes live animal offtake and milk yields against audited NDMA and KNBS price benchmarks, provides high-grade dairy share sensitivity controls, and features dasymetric disaggregation across all 290 parliamentary constituencies strictly preserving county sum identities.
highlights: Participatory Valuation Engine (Section 1.2): Decouples standing capital stock (live animal asset wealth at risk from multi-season droughts) from annual production turnover (meat offtake, milk, crops, and products).

Full Species Scope & Camel Integration: Reintegrates camels (283k head in Marsabit representing $108M standing capital and $49M annual flow) alongside cattle, goats, sheep, donkeys, pigs, and poultry.
Audited Lactation & Offtake Parameters: Zone-specific lactation coefficients (arid, semi-arid, highland) and offtake rates parameterized against NDMA county bulletins and empirical rangeland audits.
Interactive Sensitivity Controls: Real-time user parameter overrides for crop and livestock prices, offtake rates, currency toggles (KES / USD with custom FX), and high-grade dairy cow quality share.

Constrained Dasymetric Disaggregation: Spatial allocation across all 290 IEBC parliamentary constituencies using FAO GLW4, RCMRD rangeland grazing suitability, and CropGRIDS physical areas, strictly preserving county sum identities.

Beta Data Governance Compliance: Robust beta disclaimer banner, zero open-access release, zero cloud uploads, and omission of bulk CSV downloads for economic valuation assets pending formal NDMA licensing.

items: Stock-Flow Decoupling: Separates living capital wealth from annual commodity flow, rectifying severe pastoral wealth under-representation.
NDMA Sentinel Pricing: Grounded in audited annual county price medians across Kenya's 23 ASAL counties.
High-Grade Dairy Sensitivity: Dynamic adjustment of dairy cow valuation between local and high-grade quality tiers.
